verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents customizable notifications for recurring manual tasks such as annual penetration testing and quarterly access reviews. It also surfaces overdue tasks in a dashboard, supports custom fields on Tasks, and lets you assign a policy owner attribute. Together these imply a task-based workflow around non-automated evidence, but the evidence never describes per-artifact ownership, due dates, or expiry tracking on uploaded manual evidence. Missing for 10: explicit manual evidence upload workflow, per-artifact owner and due-date assignment, expiry/renewal tracking on each manual artifact, independent or hands-on corroboration.
